Welcome to Eval Author! This skill helps you build, audit, and improve evaluations against your agent’s intended behavior. Here’s what we’ll work through:

- [ ] **Check how your agent runs and how you’ll test it** — **We're here**
- [ ] **Agree on how your agent behaves using [ETHOS.md](https://github.com/NVIDIA/skills/blob/main/skills/ethos-orchestrate/README.md)**
- [ ] **Review evaluation coverage, identify gaps, and recommend improvements**

How would you like to audit your evaluations?

1. **Review tasks only –** Review scenarios, fixtures, and verifiers against your agent’s intended behavior (ETHOS.md).

2. **Full review with measured evaluation runs –** Review tasks, then analyze saved agent runs to validate that intended behaviors and tools are covered. Uses additional tokens.
